x-e-m2-05.material: Qoraa blog ah wuxuu rabaa inuu qoro tan: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' Aan hubinno weedhan xogta.

x-e-m2-05.prereq.0: Akhri weedho Ingiriis ah oo fudud (average, score, library visits)
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.prompt: Xogta waxaa la muujiyaa hal-hal. Tallaabo kasta, dooro xukunka ugu habboon adigoo isticmaalaya waxa la ogyahay ilaa hadda oo keliya.

x-e-m2-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir sida 'wada beddelma' uga duwan yahay 'beddelma sababtoo ah'.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Maxaa dhici lahaa haddii la qoro 'Library visits make scores go up' xogtan oo keliya?

x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Waxaa la caddeeyay in maktabaddu kordhiso dhibcaha.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wada beddelmid iyo ahaanshaha sabab waa arrimo kala duwan.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Booqashooyinka maktabadda iyo dhibcuhu way wada dhaqaaqaan, laakiin weli ma ognin sababta.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Xukunkani wuxuu kala saaraa xidhiidhka wada dhaqaaqa iyo sabab.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Booqashooyinka maktabadda wax kuma laha dhibcaha.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Xogtu waxay muujinaysaa inuu jiro xidhiidh. Odhanka ma jiro waa lid ku ah xogta.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Sidee xukunkaagu u beddelmi doonaa marka macluumaadkan lagu daro?
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Haddii ardayda inta badan tagta ay sidoo kale leeyihiin caadooyin kale, way adkaataa in la kala saaro haddii maktabaddu mise caadooyinkaasi ay keenaan farqiga dhibcaha.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Sababo kale, sida shaqada guriga iyo hurdada, ayaa sharxi kara labadaba dhibcaha iyo booqashooyinka.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Xukunkani wuxuu tixgelinayaa suurtagalnimada sharaxaado kale.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Waxay sii caddaatay in maktabaddu tahay sababta.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Macluumaadka cusubi beddelkeeda wuxuu ku daraa sharaxaado kale.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Xogtii ugu horreysay waxay ahayd khalad.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Macluumaadka cusub ma dafiro xogtii ugu horreysay. Wuxuu kaliya ballaariyaa fasiraadda.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Sidee u qiimeyn doontaa weedhii asalka ahayd natiijadan tijaabada?
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Kooxda booqatay waxay kor u kacday inta la mid ah kooxda aan booqan. Weedhii asalka ahayd tijaabadan ma taageerto. Waxaad sidoo kale xusuusan kartaa in muddada gaaban ay tahay xad.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Waa la xaqiijiyay in booqashooyinka maktabaddu si weyn kordhiyaan dhibcaha.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Isbeddelka labada koox waa isku mid, 1 dhibic. Kooxda booqatay ma kor u kicin wax badan.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Tijaabadan, booqashadu ma ka dhigin dhibcaha inay wax badan kordhaan.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Xukunkani wuxuu ka yimid barbar dhigidda isbeddelka labada koox.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Afar usbuuc waa gaaban yihiin, sidaas darteed waa inaan taxaddarno, laakiin ma taageero weedhii asalka ahayd.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Xukunkani wuxuu qiraa xadka natiijada laakiin wuxuu arkaa inaysan noqonayn aasaas sheegashada.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.reflect: Bilowgii waxaad odhan kartay 'way wada dhaqaaqaan' oo keliya. Macluumaadka labaad, sharaxaado kale ayaa soo muuqday, tijaabada saddexaadna, weedhii asalka ahayd way daciifowday. Ka fikir macluumaadkee ayaa beddelay xukunkaaga.
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.prompt: Qor hal ama laba weedh Ingiriis ah oo si ka fiican ugu habboon xogta marka loo eego 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' oo qoraaga blog-ka uu beddelkeeda isticmaali karo.
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.hint.0: Saddexda qaybood ee xogta, kala sooc waxa aad si hubaal ah u odhan karto iyo waxa aadan weli ogayn.
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.hint.1: Waxaad isticmaali kartaa erayo daciifiya sheegasho (may, does not prove, iwm.).
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Weedhaadu ma ku habboon tahay saddexda qaybood ee xogta oo dhan?
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Sheegashadu ma ka daciifsan tahay weedhii asalka ahayd?
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma ilaalisay qaybta hubaasha ah (wada dhaqaaqa)?

Please send me the days and start times that work.
Thanks, Hana
